name: voice.kitchen_count

description.en: A stock count said aloud (W-VOICE, P14 of docs/research/2026-10-03-depth-stock-analytics-models.md). POST /api/voice with a transcript such as 'count salmon two kilo three hundred' / 'count salmon 2,3 kg' / 'рахую лосось два кіло триста' / 'numero losos dy kile e treqind' (sq/en/uk/ru; number words compose, digits take a decimal comma or point, units kg/g/l/ml/pcs/copë) answers ONE signed proposal in the supply's integer base unit (g, ml or unit): {understood, needsConfirmation:true, verb:'count', readback, token, itemId, observed}. NOTHING IS WRITTEN by the proposal. Sending {confirm: token} back to /api/voice (within 90 s, same principal) answers {action:'do', verb:'count', args:{itemId, observed}}; the console then posts that ONE line to the EXISTING count route POST /api/owner/stock/count {session, lines:[{item, observed}]} with a client-held session id (vc_<ms>, kept while lines arrive less than 2 hours apart (COUNT_IDLE_MS)). A QUESTION, NEVER A GUESS: two supplies that fit, no supply, a missing unit (except zero), a unit of another kind than the supply's, an ambiguous '2,300' or two numbers that do not compose all answer {understood:false, say} and no token. Allowed to the owner and to staff holding the stock capability.
description.uk: Інвентаризація голосом: «рахую лосось два кіло триста» дає підписану пропозицію 2300 г; один дотик додає рядок у відкриту сесію перерахунку; неоднозначність - питання, ніколи не здогад.

producer.what: voice (route POST /api/voice; owner path line 215, kitchen staff path line 187)
said (PURE parser: verb, supply words, quantity -> integer base unit, or a question)
line (supply match, unit check, signed proposal `count:<item>|<qty>`)
count read-back in 4 languages; questions at line 56

consumer.what: header mic: proposal sheet + one-tap confirm
the EXISTING count route (W-STORE's, not edited)

secrets: QA_OWNER_EMAIL / QA_OWNER_PASSWORD (or OWNER_* of /root/.dowiz_owner naming qa-durres)

probe: node tools/live-proof/probes/voice-count.mjs (main runs it on qa-durres after deploy; VOICE_COUNT_WRITE=1 adds the one confirmed line)
